title: Add a mechanical guard: docs image tags should track packages/cli's version
body:
Found while implementing #8961 (PR #9016). #8961 itself is the second occurrence of this exact defect class — `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` (fixed by PR #8960 for #8911) and `docker/README.md` (fixed by PR #9016 for #8961) both carried the same "example image tag N majors behind `packages/cli`" staleness independently. Two occurrences of the identical drift is the threshold both #8961's body and its triage comment call out as the point where a mechanical guard becomes the durable fix, rather than fixing the next occurrence by hand a third time.

## Proposal

A new `check:*` gate — e.g. `scripts/check-docs-image-tag.mjs`, run in the same lint/docs workflow as the other `scripts/check-*.mjs` families — that keeps concrete-version docs image tags synchronized with `packages/cli/package.json`'s version.

**What it would assert**: extract every literal `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack:X.Y.Z` and `OS_CLI_VERSION=X.Y.Z` occurrence from the known doc surfaces (`docker/README.md`, `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` — enumerate explicitly rather than globbing all of `content/docs/**`, to avoid false positives on unrelated version-shaped strings) and compare each against `packages/cli/package.json`'s `version`. Fail listing `file:line` plus found vs. expected on any mismatch.

**How it would be proven capable of failing** (the reverse-verification a new gate owes): revert one occurrence to a stale version locally, confirm the gate goes red naming that exact `file:line`, then restore and confirm green.

**Known false-positive risk to design around**: `docker/README.md`'s own tag table (near the top of the file) contains `X.Y.Z` as prose describing the *pattern*, not a literal version — a naive regex would need to skip it. A concrete literal-version regex (three dot-separated integer groups) rather than a loose `X.Y.Z`-shaped match should already exclude it, but call it out explicitly in the implementation.

## Scope note

Not built in this issue — this is new gate infrastructure beyond either #8961's or #8911's three/five-line mechanical fixes, and deserves its own review of false-positive risk and which doc surfaces it should enumerate, separate from a docs-typo PR.

Related: #8961, #8911, PR #9016, PR #8960.
